title: FreightFlow event envelope
description: Every event on every freightflow.<aggregate>.v<n> topic (ADR 0023). The record key is aggregateId; the headers repeat eventId, type, schemaVersion, aggregateId and sequence.

eventId.description: UUIDv7, unique per event. Consumers deduplicate on it.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this type's schema within its topic version. An additive change raises it; a breaking change needs a new topic (ADR 0023).

occurredAt.description: When the change committed in the producer's database.

aggregateId.description: The aggregate the event is about; also the Kafka record key.

sequence.description: 1, 2, 3, ... per aggregate, without gaps, in commit order. A consumer that has applied n treats anything at or below n as stale.

actor.description: Who caused the event (ADR 0020), or null for a scheduled job such as hold expiry.

subject.description: The token's subject: an opaque Keycloak id, never a name or an email (ADR 0024).

requestId.description: X-Request-Id of the request behind the event (ADR 0015); for an outcome of a logistics payment command, the command's key; null for a scheduled job.
